profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer specializing in backend development with .NET, building scalable, secure, and resilient systems in the cloud. Over the years I have designed and delivered enterprise solutions using Azure services, event-driven architectures, and modern API standards.

While backend engineering is my strongest focus, I also have fullstack experience from building SPAs with Angular to more recent work with React and Next.js. This allows me to deliver complete, end-to-end solutions when needed.

I enjoy solving complex problems, mentoring developers, and continuously refining processes for performance, security, and maintainability. Outside of work I explore new technologies, experiment with side projects, and keep learning about software architecture and system design.
